meta.gender_ratio_byte: PERCENT_FEMALE(p) = min(254, (p*255)/100) truncated to u8; MON_MALE=0x00, MON_FEMALE=0xFE, MON_GENDERLESS=0xFF (pokeemerald/src/data/pokemon/species_info.h:1-3, include/constants/pokemon.h:169-171). female iff genderRatio > (PID & 0xFF)
meta.hidden_ability: none in Gen 3 (two ability slots; ability = PID & 1 only when slot 2 is non-zero)
meta.internal_id_note: internal ids 1..411; 252..276 are SPECIES_OLD_UNOWN_B..Z placeholders and are omitted; Hoenn species start at 277 (SPECIES_TREECKO). dex = national number
